knowledge_gaps: The diagnostic panel is underspecified: user sampling, prefix selection, maximum history length, deletion size, random repetitions, bootstrap settings, tie handling, and top-10 overlap definition need fixed values. Truncate histories before perturbation so deletion cannot introduce older interactions outside the baseline window.

Training successors may already have supervised the fitted model. These probes measure in-sample dependence, not generalization. Candidate sampling must explicitly exclude the target from negatives, padding, reserved tokens, and duplicate negatives, and define how repeated interactions and small eligible catalogs are handled.

Deleting and repacking histories changes positions as well as content. For HSTU, implemented positional or temporal biases may confound recent-information dependence. Equal-size random deletion only partially controls this; the report needs a clear account of these effects and any timestamp alignment.

The proposal needs a bounded diagnostic compute budget and an explicit rule connecting measured sensitivity to a subsequent single-model hypothesis. Originality 5 is defensible for an integration contribution; potential 8 is optimistic without evidence that sensitivity predicts validation improvement, and difficulty 3 understates reproducibility and interface testing.
